amendments.body: Thermal suppression never verifies the promised egg-dropping path. In `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:800-813`, `egg_dropping()` only fires on instability or temperature swings, not on a steady >30 C tank. The probe in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:532-608` just records `cool_egg_drops`/`warm_egg_drops` in the summary and never asserts them, so `all_shrimp_probes_summary` currently passes with both counts at zero. Either seed berried females / introduce the intended heat shock, or add a chronic-heat egg-drop mechanism, then assert the warm arm actually drops eggs.
amendments.rationale: This misses one of the stated thermal-suppression outcomes, so a regression in egg-drop behavior would go unnoticed.

amendments.body: The successful-breeding probe's "two cycles" check is weaker than the acceptance criterion. In `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:211-257`, `berried_cycle_count` is incremented once per 10-day window if any berried female appeared; `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:269-277` then treats `berried_cycle_count >= 2` as "at least 2 complete reproductive cycles". A single 14-day clutch can span two windows and satisfy this without two berried->hatch cycles. Track actual clutch/hatch transitions instead of window occupancy.
amendments.rationale: The current assertion can false-pass after retuning, so it does not actually protect the "2 complete reproductive cycles" requirement.

amendments.body: The thermal-suppression fixture is no longer isolating temperature, even though `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:425-426` says it should. The setup in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:452-487` runs 60 days with no water changes and no chemistry envelope, and the assertions in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:544-583` only compare relative readiness/juvenile counts. On the current summary run the cool control finished at NO2=2.31 mg N/L, condition=0.066, and molt_stress=1.000, so the probe can pass while the control arm is in a nitrite crash. Add guardrails that keep the cool arm chemically stable or the test is confounded.
amendments.rationale: Without control-arm stability checks, the scenario can pass for the wrong reason and becomes unreliable as a calibration probe.

payload.summary: Reviewed the current shrimp/scenario implementation and ran the targeted `tank_core` suites plus `all_shrimp_probes_summary`. The new core/runtime changes compile and the targeted tests pass, but I found three correctness gaps in the breeding and thermal scenario probes.
